notes.title: GSC Game World Birthday Sale
notes.content:
Here we are again, on these lands. The cannons are loaded, the sabers are waiting for their time…. Boots and guns are polished to a shine. We know what's coming. I can feel this smell in the air. It is a mixture of sweat, terror, gunpowder, and bread. Who are we without bread? I definitely remember that it was warmer last time. It wasn't snowing, the meadows were just beginning to bloom, but our boots mercilessly chewed the green sprouts under them. Damned be that war, it's true.

What awaits us? Another fight? Yes, undoubtedly. It will be a good battle – we have been waiting for it. My good saber is ready for all the obstacles. Whether it's a rapier, a halberd or a mace! I will meet them all with peace on my face. Because I know what I'm fighting for. And I know that this fight will not be the last.

Starting from December 5, until December 12, during the GSC Game World birthday sale, you will have the opportunity to join the fight in «Cossacks» or somewhere else in another game of ours. And as long as your hand can select units on the battlefield, the «Cossack» series will always welcome new reinforcements.

Have a successful winter offensive, Cossacks.

notes.title: The Double-A Team: weird Europe and wild history in Cossacks: European Wars
notes.content:
The Double-A Team is a feature series honouring the unpretentious, mid-budget, gimmicky commercial action games that no-one seems to make any more.

You can catch up with all of our Double-A Team pieces in our handy, spangly archive.

Cossacks! What an odd choice of infantry unit to build a game around. A very specific, Eastern European, mounted, sort of cross-era renaissance man of a soldier, at once barbaric and civilised, ordered and chaotic.

notes.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Studio GSC Announce Cossacks 3
notes.content:
Remember when S.T.A.L.K.E.R. studio GSC Gameworld grandly announced its renewed existence to the world, and how I warned you it was unlikely their next game would be a new entry in the open-world FPS series? I do hope you didn’t get your hopes up regardless.

GSC Game World today announced Cossacks 3 [official site], which is actually a remake of ye olde Cossacks: European Wars from 2001. Their return to their historical epic real-time strategy series is due later this year, and teases battles with up to 10,000 units.

notes.title: GSC Enter The Good Old Games Zone
notes.content: GSC have announced their arrival at Good Old Games with a bundled package of some of their most fondly remembered titles. Yes, it’s the Cossacks Anthology, containing Cossacks: European Wars and its two expansion packs. Now, I do have very fond memories of Cossacks’ take on the historical RTS, throwing around thousands of units at once, but of course it’s the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. games that most people know GSC for. Further titles will be appearing but I’m not even sure S.T.A.L.K.E.R. is old enough to be considered anything other than a GG. The Cossacks Anthology is available here, priced at $5.99. Maybe if everyone in the world buys it twice, S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 appears immediately?
